name: DMCM
summary: DMCM (methyl 6,7-dimethoxy-4-ethyl-β-carboline-3-carboxylate) is a drug from the β-carboline family that induces anxiety and convulsions by acting as a negative allosteric modulator of GABAA receptors — functionally opposite to benzodiazepines and related drugs which are positive allosteric modulators — and is used in scientific research for these properties to test new anxiolytic and anticonvulsant medications, respectively.

pharmacology.text: DMCM (methyl 6,7-dimethoxy-4-ethyl-β-carboline-3-carboxylate) is a drug from the β-carboline family that induces anxiety and convulsions by acting as a negative allosteric modulator of GABAA receptors — functionally opposite to benzodiazepines and related drugs which are positive allosteric modulators — and is used in scientific research for these properties to test new anxiolytic and anticonvulsant medications, respectively.

uses.text: DMCM (methyl 6,7-dimethoxy-4-ethyl-β-carboline-3-carboxylate) is a drug from the β-carboline family that induces anxiety and convulsions by acting as a negative allosteric modulator of GABAA receptors — functionally opposite to benzodiazepines and related drugs which are positive allosteric modulators — and is used in scientific research for these properties to test new anxiolytic and anticonvulsant medications, respectively.

sideEffects.en: It is not used in people. In animals it causes intense anxiety and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它不用於人體。在動物身上，它會引起強烈焦慮和癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它不用于人体。在动物身上，它会引起强烈焦虑和癫痫发作。

fact.en: DMCM does the opposite of a benzodiazepine at the same binding site: instead of calming, it causes anxiety and seizures. This makes it useful in research for testing anticonvulsant drugs.
fact.zh: DMCM 在同一個結合位點上的作用和苯二氮平相反：它不會讓人平靜，反而引起焦慮和癲癇發作。因此它在研究中被用來測試抗癲癇藥物。
fact.zhHans: DMCM 在同一个结合位点上的作用和苯二氮平相反：它不会让人平静，反而引起焦虑和癫痫发作。因此它在研究中被用来测试抗癫痫药物。
